test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Plays'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2 is** "plays".**
 
• The verb **"plays" **is used in the present tense to describe something that someone does regularly or typically.
 
• **In this context,** the sentence is describing Cristiano Ronaldo's current, regular role in football, which is that he is a forward for Real Madrid.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: * 'Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, born on February 5th, 1985 and commonly known as Cristiano Ronaldo, is a Portuguese footballer who **plays** as a forward for Spanish club Real Madrid and serves as captain 3. ______ the Portuguese national team. Ronaldo currently holds the distinction of being the most expensive player in football history after 4. ______ transferred to Real Madrid from Manchester United in a deal worth £80 million (€94m, US$132m). His contract with Real Madrid is believed to have made him the highest-paid 5. ______ player in the world.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Played: **This is the past tense of the verb "play", which would indicate that Cristiano Ronaldo used to play for Real Madrid, but does not anymore. This would contradict the information given later in the sentence.
 
• **Will play:** This is the future tense of the verb "play", which would indicate that Cristiano Ronaldo is going to play for Real Madrid in the future, but does not currently. This contradicts the context of the sentence which describes Ronaldo's current status.
 
• **Has played:** This is the present perfect tense of the verb "play", indicating an action that started in the past and has relevance to the present. However, it doesn't give the sense of an ongoing, current action as "plays" does.
